name: arith_sigma_le_mul_log
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n ≤ n * (Nat.log 2 n + 1)
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n), ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n ≤ n * (Nat.log 2 n + 1)
informal: σ(n) ≤ n(1 + ⌊log₂ n⌋) — σ(n) = Σ_{d|n} n/d ≤ Σ_{k ≤ n} ⌊n/k⌋·[k|n] ≤ n·H_n and H_n ≤ 1 + ⌊log₂ n⌋ by dyadic grouping.
